facts.tempoNote: The file has a single tempo event (quarter = 60, i.e. dotted quarter = 40). The textual tempo and rubato markings of the score are not encoded in the MIDI.
facts.anacrusis: none (the piece opens with an eighth rest inside bar 1; bar arithmetic matches \barNumberCheck in the source)
facts.pedal: No sustain-pedal (CC64) events in the file; the LilyPond source defines pedal shortcuts but never uses them.

handMapping.method: Traced from the Mutopia LilyPond source: the edition's voices are named rhUp/rhDown (right hand) and lhUp/lhDown (left hand). The source was re-rendered with one MIDI track per voice (scripts/lilypond) and every note of the bundled MIDI was matched by tick and pitch. 10 notes are written in both a right- and a left-hand voice (shared noteheads) and are left unassigned. This is the typesetter's voice layout, not fingering.
